from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional
from datetime import datetime

router = APIRouter()


class ItemUpdate(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = None
    description: Optional[str] = None
    price: Optional[float] = None


class ItemResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str
    description: str
    price: float
    updated_at: datetime


@router.put("/items/{item_id}", response_model=ItemResponse, tags=["Items"], status_code=200)
async def update_item(item_id: int, item: ItemUpdate) -> ItemResponse:
    """Mock update handler that returns an ItemResponse.

    It echoes back the provided ``item_id`` and any fields supplied in the
    request body. Missing fields are filled with placeholder values.
    """
    # Use provided values or fallback to mock defaults
    name = item.name if item.name is not None else f"Item {item_id}"
    description = (
        item.description if item.description is not None else "Default description"
    )
    price = item.price if item.price is not None else 0.0

    return ItemResponse(
        id=item_id,
        name=name,
        description=description,
        price=price,
        updated_at=datetime.utcnow(),
    )
